title: The Unexpected Tryouts
author: Petra Crane
blurb: Ulyana Zhou, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
